verdict.rationale: Docs claim the SDK exposes the 'same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code' (files, commands, web search, subagents, MCP, permissions), suggesting full parity with the UI/CLI experience. However, community reports describe the SDK's default harness as having poor observability, extensibility, and UX ('garbage harness', 'no observability'), plus new subscription restrictions blocking use of consumer plans with SDK-based apps, undermining true UI/API parity.
